name: remember
title: remember
description: Store a durable note about this project for future agent runs. Use for conventions (naming, folder layout), decisions (2D vs 3D, input scheme), and failures that should not be repeated. Notes live in .godot/ai_agent_os/memory.json and are injected into the built-in agent's system prompt on the next run.

text.description: The note to keep. Keep it short and actionable.

category.description: Optional tag such as convention, failure, decision, or note.
